diff --git a/test/units/modules/test_iptables.py b/test/units/modules/test_iptables.py
index 25a157e..deb2909 100644
--- a/test/units/modules/test_iptables.py
+++ b/test/units/modules/test_iptables.py
@@ -372,6 +372,74 @@ class TestIptables(ModuleTestCase):
             '8600'
         ])
 
+    def test_destination_ports(self):
+        set_module_args({
+            'chain': 'INPUT',
+            'protocol': 'tcp',
+            'destination_ports': ['80', '443', '8081:8083'],
+            'jump': 'ACCEPT',
+        })
+
+        with patch.object(basic.AnsibleModule, 'run_command') as run_command:
+            run_command.side_effect = [(1, '', ''), (0, '', '')]
+            with self.assertRaises(AnsibleExitJson) as result:
+                iptables.main()
+
+        self.assertTrue(result.exception.args[0]['changed'])
+        self.assertEqual(result.exception.args[0]['rule'],
+                         '-p tcp -j ACCEPT -m multiport --dports 80,443,8081:8083')
+        self.assertEqual(run_command.call_count, 2)
+        for call, action in zip(run_command.call_args_list, ('-C', '-A')):
+            self.assertEqual(call[0][0], [
+                '/sbin/iptables', '-t', 'filter', action, 'INPUT',
+                '-p', 'tcp', '-j', 'ACCEPT', '-m', 'multiport',
+                '--dports', '80,443,8081:8083',
+            ])
+
+    def test_destination_ports_with_explicit_multiport_match(self):
+        set_module_args({
+            'chain': 'INPUT',
+            'protocol': 'udp',
+            'match': ['multiport'],
+            'destination_ports': ['53', '5353'],
+        })
+
+        with patch.object(basic.AnsibleModule, 'run_command') as run_command:
+            run_command.return_value = 0, '', ''
+            with self.assertRaises(AnsibleExitJson):
+                iptables.main()
+
+        self.assertEqual(run_command.call_args[0][0], [
+            '/sbin/iptables', '-t', 'filter', '-C', 'INPUT', '-p', 'udp',
+            '-m', 'multiport', '--dports', '53,5353',
+        ])
+
+    def test_destination_ports_requires_supported_protocol(self):
+        for protocol in (None, 'icmp', 'all'):
+            set_module_args({
+                'chain': 'INPUT',
+                'protocol': protocol,
+                'destination_ports': ['80', '443'],
+            })
+            with patch.object(basic.AnsibleModule, 'run_command') as run_command:
+                with self.assertRaises(AnsibleFailJson) as result:
+                    iptables.main()
+            self.assertIn('destination_ports requires protocol', result.exception.args[0]['msg'])
+            self.assertEqual(run_command.call_count, 0)
+
+    def test_destination_ports_supported_protocols(self):
+        for protocol in ('tcp', 'udp', 'udplite', 'dccp', 'sctp'):
+            set_module_args({
+                'chain': 'INPUT',
+                'protocol': protocol,
+                'destination_ports': ['80', '443'],
+            })
+            with patch.object(basic.AnsibleModule, 'run_command') as run_command:
+                run_command.return_value = 0, '', ''
+                with self.assertRaises(AnsibleExitJson):
+                    iptables.main()
+            self.assertIn('--dports', run_command.call_args[0][0])
+
